role: mathematical/discriminating examples over existing reference functions; not empirical predictive validation

results.relation: complete own-horizon final-R threshold equals reach; when not yet reached by cut, full/rest reach agree per case
results.boundary: same frame, level and horizon; does not equate family percentages or first times

results.relation: truth-related projections can have different knowledge: known reach YES while final R UNKNOWN
same final R/X and times do not determine comparability at cut; aggregation cannot reconstruct a conditional set
same close paths do not determine wick arrival or the time of final R
equal R and X marginals do not determine a joint path claim; preserve case identity as the coupling witness
per-case event equivalence does not equate measures under different case sets/denominators
